pennant.prompt: Production transparent prop sprite sheet for The Bubble Brigade, original theatrical cel adventure. A horizontal sheet of FOUR equally sized square cells, with generous transparent separation, all showing the SAME little hanging harbor pennant in four successive breeze poses. Dark ink contour, matte gouache, cream and faded coral triangular cloth hanging from a small ochre rope. Each pennant's attachment point is exactly at the top center of its cell; same scale in all four cells. Left to right: rest sag, lifts gently right, billows farther right, settles. Broad readable hand-painted shapes matching warm cream stone and quiet teal water in an oblique overhead cartoon harbor. Each cell contains only this cloth pennant and a short top attachment rope, no posts, scenery, characters, numbers, text, frame borders, backgrounds, or shadows. GENUINE transparent alpha outside the pennants. Four cells in ONE horizontal row. Consistent frame sizes and pivots, usable as an in-game flipbook, no photorealism or 3D.
